name: Smoke Column with Helical Displacement
definition: Creates a single column of rising smoke by deforming a vertical cylinder. It disperses as it rises, starts smooth and becomes turbulent, and uses a vertical helix to displace points before calculating distance from the cylinder center to simulate bending and swirling.
summary: Smoke Column with Helical Displacement creates rising smoke by combining height-dependent density falloff with a vertical helical displacement field to bend and swirl the column.
